title: Patch: a card a Transform makes arrives as any card does: one that prints Dormant sleeps, a Phantom Shipyard stays, and a Heroic Power rolls its power
notes: R4816000: a Transform's new card on the field (zones::replace_in_zone) now starts its printed Dormant (R1839000, R3556000) and a hull's Starship memory (R1852000) beside its printed Brittle, as every arrival from off the field does (zones::place_with), and runs its start-of-game clause after its transformed (effects::transform::run_arrival_clause), so a #98 Heroic Power it makes rolls its power (R3134002). Still no summon (R1): no Tipsy stamp, no Crater Lock (R783010), no entry animation. classify stage 2 against main's build (6fea683ac5) finds S+ #103 Transcend plays differently; its own script is unchanged, so no KEPT_SCRIPTS entry: the verbs change for every catalog, and replays this change alters are refused as rules_changed (R767000).

player.title: A card a Transform makes arrives as any card does
fixes: A card a Transform makes that prints Dormant is Dormant.
A Phantom Shipyard a Transform makes stays Dormant.
A Heroic Power a Transform makes rolls its power.
